_about: Published values compared with this work. Transcribed on 26 Oct 2026 from the constants of the producers that used them (pbe_vs_exp.py, analysis/figures/figs_results.py, compare_curves_v1.py, pn_correct.py) and from the comparison table the validation report quotes; not re-checked against the papers here. P in GPa, T in K, dS in k_B per atom, dV in percent of the solid volume, dT/dP in K/GPa; null = not quoted.

_discrepancies: compare_curves_v1.py lists Alfe2009 as 330 GPa, 6200 +- 150 K and Wu2024 as 6415 K without an error; figs_results.py and pn_correct.py use 328 GPa, 6370 +- 100 K and 6420 +- 200 K (here). pn_correct.py also lists GonzalezCataldo2023 (330 GPa, 6523 +- 8 K), which no figure or report uses.
